scope: Approved transactional system-only V1, local-recipient delivery scheduling, 2 nonessential Push rolling 24h, 22:00–08:00 quiet hours, six-hour grace; no marketing; existing player screens only.

interactions.compose: draft->validate->schedule or send now with authorization
interactions.schedule: Local wall-clock 18:00 each eligible recipient; calculate due UTC per IANA timezone. 22:00–08:00 local quiet, no unknown-zone normal scheduling, 2 normal Push per rolling 24h.
interactions.send: Recheck opt-in/OS/token, real event validity, 2/rolling24h, quiet hours and expiry at dispatch; critical security only exception; never deliver marketing V1.
interactions.failure: Overdue ordinary >6h suppress Push, Inbox independent; critical only if still relevant; no burst or duplicate retries. Provider acceptance != device delivery.
interactions.preview: Official approved PuzzleQuest icon from shipped brand kit; actual system icon determined by built app package.

privacy_gates: app permission is not marketing consent
